Brief facts of the case are that on 27.08.2002 at about 5.00 pm petitioner was going from Gharaunda town to his village Kalheri on his motorcycle bearing No.HR-05F-4306 No.HR 4306 and when he had almost crossed the westeren side one way road of G.T. Road and was on the divider in between both the one way of roads, leading from Panipat to Karnal and vice versa, versa, in the meantime Jeep No.DL No.DL-3CE-3521 3521 being driven by its driver respondent No.1, in a rash and negligent manner after coming to (O&M) his extreme right hand of the road in between the divider, dashed his jeep in the motorcycle-claimant motorcycle and resultantly he received multiple grievous injuries on his person and his motorcycle was badly damaged damaged..
FIR No.285 dated 29.09.2002 was got registered under various Sections of IPC at Police Station Gharaunda against the driver of the offending vehicle.
Upon on notice of the claim petition, respondents No.1 and 2 appeared and filed joint written statement admitting the factum of accident.

6,26,000 (Rupees six lacs twenty six thousand only) along with interest @ 6% per annum.

Hence,
the claimant/appellant filed the present appeal for enhancement of compensation awarded by the Tribunal.
SUBMISSIONS OF LEARNED COUNSELS FOR THE PARTIES 6.
The learned counsel nsel for the claimant claimant-appellant contends that the compensation granted by the learned Tribunal is on lower side side..

Tribunal has ignored the fact that due to accident accident, the appellant had suffered 53%
permanent permane disability as per Ex. P-6A and has not granted the fair compensation on this account.
He further contends that the injured was a teacher and the Tribunal has not taken into consideration the loss of future earning due to the injury suffered by him in tthe he accident in question.

He further submits that the amount of compensation granted for pain and suffering,
special diet, transportation charges are also on lower side.
Moreover, the tribunal has failed to include future prospects and multiplier while assessing the compensation as per settled law.

Therefore, he prayed that the present appeal be allowed and the compensation be enhanced as per settled law.
7.
Per contra, learned counsel for respondent No.3-Insurance Insurance Company argues that the learned Tribunal nal vide award dated 31.01.2006 has rightly assessed the amount of compensation.
Therefore, he prays for dismissal of the present appeal.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the whole record of this case.

sentences.text: A perusal of the award indicates that the claimant claimant-injured injured was stated to be working as Teacher in Government School but no record of his income has been proved on the record.
In view of the same his income is assessed as 2700/- per month i.e. of a highly skilled person in accordance with the minimum wages in State of Haryana.

A perusal of the award further shows that the claimant has suffered permanent disability of 53% as is evidence from Ex.PW Ex.PW-6A.
6A.

A perusal of award further rther shows that the claimant/injured has remained hospitalized for prolonged period of time, therefore, he must have suffered pain and suffering due to the injuries suffered by him in the accident in question.
A perusal of the award further shows that no amount of compensation was awarded for future prospects and the Tribunal has failed to include multiplier while assessing the compensation.

Moreover, the amount of compensation granted for pain and suffering, loss of amenities,,
transportation charges, attendant attendant charges and special diet is also on lower side.

Therefore,
the award requires interference by this court.
